query: What do Motorola Moto G Power (2022) buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?
search_text: What do ) buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?

rows.text: AT&T buyers BEWARE. This is not a down play on the phone itself but a caution about compatibility of the carrier. I received this phone on 3/28/22 went to the local AT&T store for sim card and set up. They set it up with new sim card but were not able to have it call out. They called AT&T tech support and were told that the MOTO G Power 2021 models XT2117-2, 2021 XT2117-4 was not set up to work on their new 5G system even though it is on AT&Ts compatible list. This is due to the fact that it is NOT an AT&T "Branded" phone. If it had been activated before the 5G roll out it would have worked. But of course they tried to sell me a lesser phone for an inflated price or a 36 month contract.

Pretty decent so far. The phone works well so far, but the SIM tray was really annoying to work with. Other than that, it is definitely compatible with my carrier (Mint), so I'm glad it seems like a truly unlocked phone. Seems decent for the price and just overall.

Unlocked phone that is locked to a carrier. Received and tried to activate. Carrier advises that it is locked to another carrier and they are not able to add it to the network. Contacted Amazon support, they helped me get manufacturer contact number. Contacted manufacturer and they were not able to assist. Will have to return.

NOT COMPATIBLE. This phone was advertised as unlocked, specifically mentions Verizon as a carrier that it is compatible with... I even had to get online with Verizon help to see what I was doing wrong. It wasn't me. The phone is not recognized by verizon. Not the model, the phone itself. SCAM. DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT.

BEWARE - NOT UNLOCKED. NOT UNLOCKED! I just spent 45 minutes on the phone with my carrier trying to get this phone activated only to be told that it wasn't possible because it was locked. The carrier told me this type of scam is common. Beware!

Not compatible. I took this to two different phone carriers and was told it wasn’t compatible with one and the other told me the phone wasn’t unlocked so now I just have a random phone that isn’t connected to any network

Unlocked for all carriers; Sike!. The phone in itself is beautiful! Quality screen, started right up, all features worked as described in description. It was heavier and bulkier than I thought it would have been but I could have easily gotten over that as long as I would have been able to use my phone with my service provider sim as I had planned. All carrier unlocked DOES NOT include assurance wireless which is part of the T-Mobile network. Major letdown, I feel that should have specified.

Don't buy this device. I had the same problem the buyer "Emilia" had. I bought this phone cause it is suppose to be unlocked. I got it and found out it is locked to Verizon as the other buyer stated. You think Amazon would take this item off their site cause it's false advertising. It is not made for T-Mobile, AT&T. It's only for Verizon. Poor seller too.

NOT UNLOCKED-SCAM. PLEASE READ THE MANY REVIEWS REGARDING "NOT UNLOCKED" After almost 3 months of usage, an "invalid SIM card" message locked up the phone. After a visit to the Verizon store... AND 2 hours on the phone and chat with Verizon, I'm told this phone is NOT COMPATIBLE with the Verizon network. This is a scam. I'm thinking Amazon is not going to refund our money as it's been over 3 months. BEWARE, YOU'VE BEEN WARNED NOT TO WASTE YOUR MONEY!

wifi calling on this cell isn't compatible with at&t. It doesn't work. I bought this unlocked moto G power compatible with all the carriers... maybe ? But not all the features are compatible ? I wanted to use this cell with wifi calling. But it doesn't work with at&t ? So it's why I'm returning it. I didn't know before because I didn't have the IMEI

Phone was reported Lost or Stolen approximately 5 months after purchasing. I received a message from my carrier today advising phone had been shutdown by Sprint (not my carrier). The message advised that I contact Sprint directly. After hours texting with customer service I was told to contact Boost as phone was reported lost/stolen. Contacted Boost was told that my phone could not have been reported today without a Boost account. Now I have a non-functional phone and appear to be out of options. Would appreciate a refund.

Buyers Beware! Can't Receive Text Messages & No Voicemail. This is the first time that I bought a phone that is "Unlocked for the freedom to choose your carrier. Compatible with AT&T, Sprint, T-Mobile, and Verizon networks. " Well, it can't be used on Visible (prepaid company by Verizon). It kind of works on TotalWireless(using Verizon network) BUT! it cannot receive text messages and its voicemail does not work. VERY DISAPPOINTED. I will probably keep it unless I find a major problem.

Reception is similar. This phone has more Moto branding and what might be a little more bloatware than my E4+, but it's not obtrusive and I haven't felt any need to disable it. It's NOTHING like the bloatware you get on a Samsung device. The phone reports "5G" and "5G+" in the status bar when in fact it is not connecting to 5G bands, but 4G bands. This is a known marketing bodge by T-Mobile (and other carriers, AT&T is the worst). But Lenovo lists the actual 5G radio bands in this phone's specs, so I feel future proofed. If you're curious about that, install the SignalSpy app and check your local bands. I'm using the Red Pocket MVNO and SIMs to access T-Mobile's network and this phone works perfectly. As long as Lenovo makes these great unlocked Moto phones, I'll keep using them.

Original purchase was not unlocked, had to return. The original purchase was a locked phone and caused me big headaches of having to work through it with my service carrier. After much troubleshooting, my service carrier assured that the sim problems were being caused by the phone being locked. I returned it and got a replacement and new one worked like a charm, right out of the box. Not happy about having a received a non-functioning phone to begin with, but I am very pleased with the way the replacement was handled. I received the replacement home very quickly along with instructions and label for returning the original one.
LOCKED TO BOOST MOBILE. Advertised as fully unlocked phone, but it's locked to Boost mobile, even the packaging is boost mobile, very disappointed. Can't use my carrier/current plan.

It's unlocked to use with any carrier sim card, it has Bluetooth, WiFi calling capabilities, fast processor for emails, Internet usage and streaming, great camera, and ease of transferring all my apps from my other phone. (I did have to lookup those last steps online but then it was very simple.) I also had a service provider rep's help to get my service (new service ordered online) working. He was able to do this by installing a new SIM card (even though the one I had received was new, I just couldn't get it to work and neither could reps over the phone.) It was so great he took that extra step without making a sale himself! AT&T rep. I've had the phone this past week and it's working great.

Works OK but I think it was a used phone sold as NEW. The phone works ok but the battery seems worn out and it came with software on it for another carrier. That indicates to me the phone was used. It took me 2 hours to figure out how to remove the software and make it unlocked so I could sign up for my carrier. Even though I had my SIM card in, it would default to another carrier. It was sold to me as a new phone.
NOT VERIZON COMPATIBLE!!!. Took this to two Verizon stores, one was a corporate store and both told me during the activation process that Verizon was not recognizing it.

Unable to actually use. I bought this phone that's supposed to be globally unlocked and my carrier is on the list of company's it will work with but does it... No! It keeps telling me I have to contact the former company for a code and that company tells me it should already be unlocked to use! So not worth almost $200 to get ripped off.

It's NOT Unlocked! And Boost Mobile says it is not eligible to be unlocked. Moto G Power.. Been working with my carrier for the last three weeks to figure out why this phone won't hold the account. It keeps defaulting to T-Mobile (not mine) every couple days. Thought the SIM was bad and reset it several time hoping it would stabilize, it did not. Well it turns out the phone is somehow locked to T-Mobile, should be an unlocked phone but will not hold another carrier pass 24-36 hours it reverts back to T-Mobile every time. Now I check for return and I am one day late... Let me return this very lightly used not a scratch on it phone and my review will change.
